rows.grounds: fused form combining proktam and abdānāṃ

items.question: What two things do the wise state in the fifth section regarding the varṇaka of years?
premises: The fifth section states two things.
The wise state the varṇaka of years.
items.inference: Two items are taught by the wise in the fifth section concerning the varṇaka of years.
uncertainties: The fused token proktamabdānāṃ may combine proktam and abdānāṃ, so its exact syntactic relation is uncertain.
items.plain_english: In the fifth section, the wise state two things concerning the varṇaka of years.
